isolation.environment: Child commands receive only PATH, LANG and scratch-local TMPDIR/XDG/AI_MEMORY_DATA_DIR plus disabled Git global configuration. No API credentials are forwarded.
isolation.retention: Binaries/state remain only in scratch. Raw captures remain private. Published files are deterministic masked derivatives.

install.method: Publisher's prebuilt release archive, sidecar verification and prefix extraction
install.adaptation: The upstream documented GitHub-backend route downloads, verifies and extracts this archive. The same publisher archive is fetched directly and extracted into scratch to avoid global mise activation.

capture_policy.raw_custody: Raw native files and exact command journal retained privately, named raw-native-outputs/<label>.txt and raw-native-commands.jsonl. No raw-capture digest is published.
capture_policy.published_hash: SHA-256 of each published derivative's bytes only.
capture_policy.replacement: Exact scratch-root bytes -> <SCRATCH>. No decoding, newline conversion, ANSI removal or content generation.
capture_policy.supersession: All unpublished normalized first-pass captures and the recorder-generated cargo-unavailable message are withdrawn. This receipt uses re-captured native output; env itself produced the missing-cargo error.
